Who is Shatrujeet Singh Kapur, the ITBP Director General whose remarks on the India-China border have sparked a fresh political controversy?
On October 22, 2026, ITBP DG Shatrujeet Kapur spoke about ongoing face-offs in Arunachal Pradesh, the role of Shaurya Commandos, and the urgent need to modernise the force's weapons and drone capabilities.
